title: Fictional Jordan Vale cover letter version 2

content.text: Application for Community Centre Support Assistant
FICTIONAL EXAMPLE ONLY. Replace or remove every example fact.
I am applying for the Community Centre Support Assistant role, reference 0007. I am interested in helping visitors find the information and sessions they need.

As a volunteer reception helper at Eastbank Community Room from September 2025 to February 2026, I welcomed visitors and explained room locations using a printed session list. I referred booking enquiries to the coordinator rather than making decisions outside my role.
I also entered attendance totals in a simple spreadsheet and checked them against the paper register. This is relevant to your requirement to keep simple attendance records accurately.

Your revised brief asks for short written handovers. At Eastbank Community Room, I updated a handover note with pending questions and room changes after my shift. This gave the next volunteer a written record to consult.
Thank you for considering my application.
